name: context
description: What a working conversation asserts: causes, dependencies, use and I/O, deployment, impact, ownership, and the decisions a team makes (chosen / rejected / verified) - in English and Chinese, because the turns of a session are rarely one language.

rules.name: caused
rules.between: ^(?:caused|causes|leads? to|led to|triggers?|triggered)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:导致|导致了|引起|引起了|造成|造成了|触发|触发了)$

rules.name: was-caused-by
rules.between: ^(?:was|is|were) caused by(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:由|是因为)$

rules.name: fixed
rules.between: ^(?:fixed|fixes|resolved|mitigated|repaired)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:修复|修复了|修好|解决了|解决了|缓解了)$

rules.name: reverted
rules.between: ^(?:reverted|rolled back|undid)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:回滚|回滚了|撤销|撤销了|退回了)$

rules.name: replaced
rules.between: ^(?:replaced|replaces|supersedes|superseded)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:替换|替换了|取代|取代了|换成了)$

rules.name: depends-on
rules.between: ^(?:depends on|relies on|requires|needs)$|^(?:依赖|依赖于|依赖着|需要)$

rules.name: depended-on-by
rules.between: ^(?:is|was) (?:depended on by|required by)$|^(?:被依赖)$

rules.name: uses
rules.between: ^(?:uses|used|consumes|calls|invokes)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:使用|使用了|调用|调用了|走)$

rules.name: is-used-by
rules.between: ^(?:is|was) used by$|^(?:被调用)$

rules.name: reads
rules.between: ^(?:reads|read|queries)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:读取|读了|查询)$

rules.name: writes
rules.between: ^(?:writes|wrote|inserts|persists)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:写入|写了|落)$

rules.name: part-of
rules.between: ^(?:is|was) part of(?: the)?$|^(?:属于|归属)$

rules.name: deployed-on
rules.between: ^(?:is|was) deployed on(?: the)?$|^(?:runs on)$|^(?:部署在|部署到|运行在|跑在)$

rules.name: affects
rules.between: ^(?:affects|affected|impacts?|impacted)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:影响|影响了|波及)$

rules.name: blocked
rules.between: ^(?:blocks?|blocked|prevents?|prevented)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:阻塞|阻塞了|挡住|阻止|卡住)$

rules.name: owns
rules.between: ^(?:owns|owned)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:负责|负责了|拥有)$

rules.name: is-owned-by
rules.between: ^(?:is|was) owned by$|^(?:归)$

rules.name: assigned-to
rules.between: ^(?:is|was) assigned to(?: the)?$|^(?:指派给|分配给|交给了)$

rules.name: decided
rules.between: ^(?:decided|agreed|chose|chosen|adopted|picked)(?: on| to)?(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:决定|决定了|采用|采用了|选了|选定)$

rules.name: rejected
rules.between: ^(?:rejected|ruled out|dropped|abandoned)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:否掉|否了|放弃了|排除|排除了|不采用)$

rules.name: verified
rules.between: ^(?:verified|confirmed|validated|reproduces)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:验证|验证了|确认|确认了|实测|复现)$

rules.name: reported
rules.between: ^(?:reported|reports|found)(?: the| a| an)?$|^(?:报告|上报|发现|发现了)$
